name: Litho
tagline: A VS Code assistant that turns plain-English specs into chip-design code, tests it and plots the waveforms.
problem: Hardware engineering lacks unified AI tooling; teams patch together their own workflows, the team says.
solution: Four agents (orchestrator, spec, writer, tester) generate RTL from descriptions, write and run Verilator tests, and render signal waveforms in the editor.
demo_moment: Team-described: describe a module, get code, passing tests and waveforms in VS Code.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Splits agents by role to keep each context narrow.

lessons: Bring coding agents to an underserved engineering niche with its own test loop.
